cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Make It Their Idea
cards.instruction: Make an unwanted task sound appealing enough that someone volunteers for it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. You have such a good eye for storage. Sorting our shed could finally give your tools a proper home.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Until you dump paint tins everywhere again.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. You could assign every shelf. I'd follow your labels.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Including a shelf you're forbidden to touch?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Absolutely. You could put it at eye level so I see what I'm missing.

mechanism: A uses patron-like superiority to grant disposal and shelf privileges that make shed clearing attractive.
confusable: Unlike neutral surrender of control, A must present each incentive as permission issued from above.
comparison: Protected tool space and disposal rights differ from wedding artistry and family criticism.
seedUse: Canonical D05-b supplies storage autonomy as incentive; S01-b supplies condescending approval of initiative.
